title: Weekly Product Changelog - November 16, 2026
summary: Added Drag tasks into your other tools. Drag a Sunsama task onto the Asana, ClickUp, Linear, Todoist, Google Tasks, monday, Microsoft To Do or Microsoft
body_markdown:
[Sunsama](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/)


[Home](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/)[Feedback](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/improvements)


Feedback

[← Back to changelog](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/changelog)[Powered by Canny](https://canny.io/powered-by-canny?utm_source=changelog_subdomain&utm_medium=powered&utm_campaign=sunsama&company=Sunsama)


Added


- Drag tasks into your other tools. Drag a Sunsama task onto the Asana, ClickUp, Linear, Todoist, Google Tasks, monday, Microsoft To Do or Microsoft Planner panel to export it there. Hold ⌘/Ctrl while dragging to copy and link it instead.
- Non-blocking calendars. Set a calendar as non-blocking so its events stay visible but tasks can be scheduled over them. You can also ask Sunny to do this.
- Gmail upgrades. Replies and forwards include your Gmail signature. GitHub notification emails link straight to their PR or issue, so you can preview it and add it to your day.
- Connect more apps to Sunny. Any app with an MCP server, like Sentry, can now be connected so Sunny and Autoplan can work with what's in it.
- Autoplan + Apple Reminders. Autoplan can plan from your Apple Reminders in the Mac app. Press ⌘↵ (Ctrl+↵ on Windows) to plan straight from the braindump box.
- Faster task creation. Hover over an integration item and press A to create a task with the title and link already filled in.


Improved


- A fresh look for planning your day and week. Today is now the default view, and Today, Board and Calendar each have their own spot in the left nav. Pick a date and the view slides to it, with a "Back to today" shortcut.
- Weekly objectives, upgraded. Objectives have their own This week page, show beside Today's tasks, and open in the right-hand panel from any view (press Shift+R). They now have notes and show actual vs. planned time. Drag a task onto an objective to link it, or drag an objective onto a day to plan a task for it.
- Smarter Autoplan. It puts meetings and meals on your calendar instead of making them tasks, and pins tasks to times you give ("read with Maya at 8"). It plans work into focus blocks and all-day blocks like "WORK" instead of pushing it to tomorrow, and writes its briefing in the language you used.


Fixed


- Live updates and the "Can't connect to Sunsama" banner work reliably again, including on work networks and VPNs
- Adding a task during daily planning goes to the day you're planning instead of the backlog
- The Board no longer freezes when you scroll ahead through busy days
- Tasks on your calendar follow your task list's order again
- "Add to tasks" on a calendar event no longer shows errors
- Menus near the edge of the screen or a Kanban column no longer get cut off
- Clicking a recipient's name in the reply composer no longer removes them, and the invite modal's "Copy link" button works again
